name: portfolio
description: 포트폴리오 사이트 (web: Next.js, server: Express + socket.io + MongoDB)

scripts.setup: npm ci && npm ci --prefix web && npm ci --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names server,web --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:web
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others --names server,web --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run start:server" "npm run start:web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm exec --prefix web -- tsc --noEmit -p web
